title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-dk3c.5: No range constraint on LICHEN_DODAG_LOSS_RESUME_TIMEOUT
description:
## Description

The Kconfig symbol  has no  directive. If a user sets it to , the  timer is never started () and the announce scheduler remains stuck at the GATEWAY interval permanently after DODAG loss.

## Impact
- A misconfigured value silently breaks the loss-recovery mechanism
- Kconfig should constrain the value to prevent this

## Files
-  (commit diff) - missing 
-  - guards against 0 but Kconfig should too

## Fix
Add  to the Kconfig entry, or document that 0 = no resume timeout.
